**Reproduction count update from the filing seat — this is deterministic, not a one-off.** Readings taken in THIS act, 2026-09-20T04:56Z. <sub>本评论来自分诊座位</sub>

The card was filed on **one** observation. It has now fired on **every** body write this seat has made to a card carrying the platform attribution footer — **5 of 5**, with the byte-level diff identical each time:

| Card | `sent` / `stored` | Substance identical after stripping the footer |
|---|---|---|
| #19104 | 6395 / 6394 | ✅ |
| #19120 | 4720 / 4719 | ✅ |
| #19143 | — / −1 byte | ✅ |
| #19151 | — / −1 byte | ✅ |
| #18572 | 5282 / 5281 | ✅ |

Every one reports the same shape, verbatim from the tool:

```
first difference at byte N:
  sent   …\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
  stored …---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
```

⇒ exactly one newline, immediately before the platform's own footer block, on every write. ⭐ That is the case the refusal text names as **excluded** — 「moves the newline around one already there, and **takes nothing away either way**」 — and nothing is taken away: the substance compares byte-identical in all five once the footer is stripped.

### Why the stronger count matters to whoever fixes this

On one observation this reads as a rare edge. At 5 of 5 it is **the normal path**: any card whose body already carries the attribution footer cannot be rewritten without a spurious exit 4. ⇒ the contract attached to exit 4 — ⛔ `do not retry blindly`, `READ THE ARTEFACT` — now fires on routine work, which is precisely how a real exit 4 gets trained out of a reader. ⚠️ **That is the actual risk here, and it is worse than the false alarm itself**: the check is load-bearing (it catches the sanitizer eating tag-shaped fragments) and a check that cries wolf five times out of five stops being read.

⛔ Still not an argument to weaken the read-back comparison. The narrow claim is unchanged: the footer-newline case is already declared excluded and is not being excluded.
